title: Platelet-rich-plasma Treating Tennis Elbow
brief_summary: The study is to compare the efficacy of autologous platelet concentrate injections to corticosteroid injection in patients suffering from tennis elbow with respect to pain and function.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient with chronic epicondylitis lateralis who do not react to conservative treatment and therefore are send to the orthopedic surgeon

Exclusion Criteria:
